findings_and_revisits.reasoning: The current selector restricts authored availability and continuation, and begin_attack_timed checks posture/downed before constructing checked tangent and start coordinate before queued or idle state assignment. Tangent checks finite/nonnegative and pose coordinate checks finite; recovery/preparation spans use a minimum of one. The immediate melee branch propagates InvalidAnimationValue while buffering busy, but buffered melee returns Ok for any transition error without removing its buffered request. The ranged branch likewise discards any transition error, but the earlier published current trace shows this particular ranged call constructs continuation=false and cannot enter the checked continuation branches in the shown path.
findings_and_revisits.conditions_and_limits: A concrete invalid transition and supported buffered producer/configuration remain unproved. The previously published assessment records only a hypothetical finite overflow under a very large permitted numerical maximum and contrasts committed ordinary YAML; no modified configuration, live behavior or failed gameplay was established. We did not independently read installed config, all producers, host warning path or native network. No invented zero-denominator claim: initial assignment normalizes curves and timeline enforces minimum interval in the inspected path; wire/direct construction and all state owners remain open.
